# Lincoln Park Sheffield

> Sheffield is a mid-rise residential building in Lincoln Park, a cluster of five low-rise blocks at Arjan in Dubailand, Dubai. It rises six floors above ground over a single basement and holds studio, one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with shops and restaurants at street level. The Chicago-inspired design uses ornamented entrances, domed windows and roof terraces. Shared facilities include a gymnasium, a temperature-controlled swimming pool and covered parking.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Arjan, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed
- Year: 2014

## MENASCO Scope

Sheffield is a mid-rise commercial and residential building within Lincoln Park, a five-building development by DAMAC Properties at Arjan in Dubailand, a community master-planned by Mizin. Its Chicago-inspired design features ornamented entrances, domed windows and roof terraces, with studio to three-bedroom apartments. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the B+G+6 building.
